What is Leapsome?

Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams. Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.

Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone, and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.

Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!

Your Opportunity

Leapsome is looking for a Head of Growth & Lifecycle to architect and lead the engine behind our next stage of global expansion. Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you will join the Marketing Leadership Team to own the strategy and execution of our high-stakes demand engine. Today 95% of revenue is marketing led, and we’re looking for the leader to continue to lead and scale the function accountable for Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs), qualified pipeline, and customer expansion revenue.

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on marketing leader based in Berlin who wants to build a modern, AI-augmented growth engine to unlock our next phase of maturity. As we evolve from a people enablement tool to a comprehensive HR platform, your mission is to transform our buyer journey into a scalable, high-velocity machine.

You are a high-output, low-ego operator who leads with clarity, urgency, and empathy. You possess thehigh agency required to materially shift the growth trajectory of a category-defining company across North America and EMEA. You aren’t just an observer of the AI revolution; you are bullish on its potential to enhance human creativity and efficiency. You are constantly researching and experimenting with new ways to integrate technology—from autonomous workflows and predictive lead scoring to intent-driven prospecting—to drive superior, self-optimizing results.

This is a unique opportunity to shape global strategy while staying close to the execution of our demand engine across North America and EMEA. You will bridge the gap between initial acquisition and long-term customer retention, ensuring our marketing tactics match our expanding vision as a comprehensive HR platform.

WHAT ARE YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES?

hiring_jobs.description:
About Dioptra (an Icertis company)Contracts are still processed by hand, even though the work touching them — ERP, CLM, email, Slack/Teams, SharePoint, Word, Excel, procurement systems — spans a dozen disconnected tools. Most of the effort in contracting isn't judgment or drafting; it's gluing those systems together.Dioptra is building Contract OS: an agentic platform that does that gluing for you. Agents draft, negotiate, and review pre-signature; extract, monitor, and operationalize post-signature; and execute workflows across every system a contract touches — turning contracts from documents people process into live objects agents operate. We work deep inside the enterprise contracting stack (Icertis, SAP, SharePoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams), which means real technical depth, real enterprise customers, and a market that's actively shifting toward AI-native tooling in real time.We're a small, technical team that ships fast and holds a high bar. This is a founding-level seat with direct access to the founders and real ownership from day one.
The RoleThis role is a growth scientist role who also happens to be a content creator: you'll build and operate a fleet of AI agents to run top-of-funnel experiments — messaging, channels, creative, acquisition cost — with real rigor (hypotheses, measurements, iterations). And you'll make the content that fuels those experiments yourself: product videos, launch assets, landing pages, ad creative — end to end. This role rewards high agency: you write your own brief, ship the thing, and iterate.Above all, we're looking for a founder's instinct. You own the outcome end to end. You dig into why and fix it. You move with urgency when the brief is half-written, and you know when to trust the model and when your own judgement has to override it — especially with budget or brand on the line.
Here's what that looks like day to day, and what it takes to do it well:Build an experimentation engine, not a task list. Stand up a fleet of agents that can generate, launch, and evaluate top-of-funnel experiments at a pace no human-only team could match: message variants, landing page tests, ad creative permutations, channel tests. This means you've actually built agent workflows before, not just used a chatbot to write copy — you're comfortable being the one who builds the system, not the one who requests it.Run growth like a science. Design experiments with clear hypotheses and success criteria across paid, organic, SEO/AEO, lifecycle, and partnerships. Track CAC, conversion, and payback rigorously; kill what doesn't work fast and double down on what does, and explain why something worked, not just that it did. That requires a real track record: you've designed and run structured growth experiments — A/B or multivariate — with actual budget accountability, and you're comfortable pulling your own numbers rather than waiting for a dashboard someone else built.Make the content yourself. Script, shoot, and edit product videos and launch content, and write landing pages, launch narratives, and campaign copy for a technical, enterprise buyer (legal, procurement, GTM ops). Show us launch videos you've made that drove real outcomes, and writing samples.Own launches end to end. Positioning, sequencing, the video, the follow-on content that keeps a launch alive for weeks instead of days.Report on outcomes, not activity. You're measured on pipeline, signups, and CAC efficiency — not impressions or a content calendar filled.Partner with product and founders. Sit in on roadmap conversations, bring market signal back, and shape what gets built and how it's positioned. This is easier if you genuinely care about the buyer — you don't need a legal or procurement background, but you should care how enterprise legal/GTM/ops teams think, what they read, and what makes them trust a new tool.
You'll have an edge if:You've worked at an early-stage startup (seed to Series B), even in a non-marketing role or you’re a past founder.You have 5+ years of relevant experience including marketing into enterprise, other technical B2B category with a similarly sophisticated buyer, software engineering etc.You've built or contributed to an internal automation/agent stack yourself, not just used one someone else built.You've run performance marketing or paid acquisition at a B2B SaaS company with real budget ownership.You have experience creating your own content.You're comfortable with light scripting or coding agents to build growth infrastructure without needing an engineer.
The Team You'll Work WithYou'll work directly with the founders of Dioptra, not through layers of management. Dioptra's engineering culture holds a high bar — clean, deliberate work, iterative — and you'll be expected to bring the same rigor to growth and content that the team brings to the product itself. Given how early this seat is, you'll also be one of the people setting the tone for how “marketing” gets done here going forward.

The Growth Marketing Manager will own marketing initiatives to drive awareness, interest, and qualified traffic and leads. Campaign Leadership & Strategy

Own the end-to-end planning, development, and execution of integrated multi-channel marketing campaigns, anchored to a clear campaign theme, KPIs, and strategic objectives. Bring forward original campaign ideas and proactively propose new approaches based on market trends, competitive activity, and performance data. Collaborate with Product Marketing and Lifecycle & Content Marketing Managers to ensure consistent messaging across all channels, campaigns, and web pages. Quickly design and revise necessary graphics, often with the support of templates, in Figma, Adobe InDesign, and Photoshop as needed. Agile in finding quick solutions to graphic design needs and using AI and other tools to scale and create visual content quickly. Consider visual content as foundational to campaign planning and success. Write on-brand, clear content for ads, emails, and landing pages as needed, ensuring that content aligns to campaign goals and resonates with the target audience. Collaborate with Product Marketing Manager and Lifecycle and Content Marketing Manager to revise as needed. Build and maintain campaign reporting dashboards in HubSpot and Salesforce. 

Paid Media & Channel Ownership

Plan, execute, and optimize Google Search, Display, Pmax, and paid social campaigns, including keyword strategy, bidding, and creative testing. Completely own these channels without vendor support. Significantly reduce CPA through landing page rebuilds and optimization and innovative optimization and bidding strategies. Own and actively manage ABM (account-based marketing) channels, including platform selection, audience strategy, and performance optimization. Demonstrate expert-level skill in list-building and segmentation optimization across LinkedIn, programmatic display, content syndication, and other ABM channels. hiring_jobs.description:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?

The Tyk AI and API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!)

If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.

Our Mission

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.

Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.

If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.

Why this role, why now

Tyk spent a decade becoming essential infrastructure for some of the world's biggest companies. We're now doing the same thing for the AI era — and we want someone to help us move marketing through that shift. It's a rare moment: a profitable, established company moving fast into new territory, with a small enough team that you'll shape the direction, not just execute it.

Requirements

Here’s what you’ll be getting up to:

This is a doing role. You’ll own initiatives end-to-end - planning them and then executing them yourself, with AI as a force multiplier.

Own campaigns and launches end-to-end. Write the brief, build the assets and copy, ship the campaign or launch, and report on how it did - you don’t hand any part of that off to someone else or an agency.Run events from first invite to final follow-up. Own the details of owned, sponsored and community events - logistics, outreach, on-the-day readiness, and the follow-up sequence that turns attendees into pipeline.Use AI as a force multiplier, not a novelty. Build tools like Claude or ChatGPT into your day-to-day - research, first drafts, campaign builds, reporting - so you can output like a bigger team, ship like an engineer, and bring the rest of the marketing team along with you.Turn a priority into a plan with your name on it. Take “we should do X” and turn it into a scoped plan - timeline, owner, success metric - then execute it yourself rather than delegating the “how.”Keep GTM moving across Marketing, Sales and Product. Chase the people, approvals and information you need across teams so initiatives don’t stall, and make sure what you ship lands with real commercial impact, not just activity.Report on what worked. Track the metrics that actually show impact for each initiative (pipeline influenced, cost, conversion, attendance - whatever fits), share the results even when they’re not flattering, and use them to decide what to do next.

Here’s What We’re Looking For

2–3 years’ experience as a marketing manager, growth marketer or similar - background matters less than what you’ve built and how you think. B2B SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement; agency background is welcome, especially if you’ve built things from scratch for multiple clients.A builder, not just a contributor. You’ve made something from scratch - a campaign, a launch, a side project, a small business - and you can point to it and say “I built that.”A strategic executor. You can zoom out to see the bigger picture, then zoom back in and do the work yourself, rather than handing the “how” to someone else.Commercially minded. You think in pipeline and revenue, not just opens and impressions, and you can talk through a deal or a campaign you helped move forward.A self-starter. You manage competing priorities and deadlines without being managed, and you raise problems before they become fire drills.Genuinely into AI. You already use tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your own work, and you have real opinions about where AI is taking marketing - not just enthusiasm for the idea of it.Hungry for ownership. You’re at the point in your career where you want real responsibility, and you’re looking for a team small enough that you get it fast.Comfortable with - or quick to pick up - Monday.com and HubSpot. You don’t need hand-holding on the basics of project management or marketing ops tools.

Is this right for you?

This role is for you if…

You love building and shipping things yourself, and want a lot of ownershipYou’re excited by the idea of helping shape an AI-first marketing team from the frontYou thrive in a small, senior team where everyone does the work

It’s probably not for you if…

You’re mainly looking to manage a team or oversee others’ work You prefer a big, structured organisation with lots of specialists to delegate toYou want to focus on strategy and planning rather than execution

Benefits

Here’s why you should join us:

Everyone has unlimited paid holidays. We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.Employee share schemeGenerous maternity and paternity leaveVolunteering DaysCompany retreatsEmployee Wellbeing platform

We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? - to make what we do even better!

Our values tell the story of Tyk - here’s how:

It’s ok to screw up! 

We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones - so try it, at least we can say we have!

The only stupid idea, is the untested one! 

It’s in our DNA - starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free - sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!

Trust starts with you - make it count! 

Trust is a two-way street - instil it from day one!

Assume best intent! 

We have each other’s back - we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act.

Make things better! 

Always try to leave things better than when you found them - change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.

What’s it like to work here?! check it out: https://tyk.io/worklife/

Tyk is an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

You can see more about us here https://tyk.io
